## Summary

Webflow and WordPress developer with strong PHP, CSS, and JavaScript who ships faster with agentic AI (Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, MCP) for US clients. Pioneered AI workflows that cut landing-page edits from days to hours and performance optimization from 90 to 20 minutes (GTmetrix Grade F to A). Built an open-source Client-First Agent Skill for Webflow. Fluent in English (EF SET C2) and Spanish; remote-ready.
